Both acceptance criteria of the card are met by this text. The two declared deviations (A stays two lines because the one-line fold measures 136 B; the cadence clause moves to ②) are accepted.

**The one refusal — the funding of the rider line**: the new SKILL.md :35 「发布窗口「已上膛」判据与其真读法住 `references/dispatch-runbook.md` 落卡与裁决记录细则。」 is paid by joining :66–:67 (「一轮 = …为止。」 + 「轮次报告是轮末给维护者的汇报,⛔ 不是停止信号。」) into one line. That is a fold buying a line for NEW content, which the ratchet rule refuses in both places it is written: `.claude/agents/os-dev.md` :293–:294 「付行数棘轮的唯一合法货币是删内容:⛔ 不拿 re-wrap(折行合并)当筹行,新增以删减付账。」 / 「密度优化只随净减内容的 PR;分界只问折行有没有为新增内容买行。」 and `references/lanes/skills.md` :22 「棘轮逐行付账,⛔ re-wrap 筹行」. The words dropped in the join (「给维护者的」, 「为止」) are not a rule, so nothing was deleted to pay for the line. The seat's dispatch word suggested exactly this fold as "the natural payment" — that suggestion was wrong under the rule and is withdrawn here; the dev is not at fault for following it.

**Fix (one of two, the first preferred)**:
1. Restore :66–:67 to their `origin/main` spelling and drop the :35 pointer line from this PR. The rider then rides the next SKILL.md PR that carries a genuine deletion (the seat re-records it on the seat post; #17742 / #17497 are next on the SKILL.md chain). Net result: SKILL.md 812 → 812 with the :71–:72 rewrite alone; nothing else changes.
2. Keep :35 and pay it by deleting one SKILL.md line whose rule survives verbatim elsewhere in the corpus — a true duplicate, ⛔ not the SKILL.md ↔ core-rules mirror pair (core-rules is a subset by design) — citing the surviving line in the PR body. Take this only if such a line is found without a judgment call; otherwise 1.

Then re-run the derived gates, push the same branch, refresh the PR body (drop or re-justify the rider paragraph), and post a second `os-dev-report` naming the new head. The PR stays draft.
